verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents Graph API primitives: per-message update/delete, a categories master list, flagging, and Inbox rules for incoming mail. These are developer building blocks or adjacent automation, and nothing documents selecting many conversations in the product and archiving, labeling, or marking them done in one action.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
